steps: Open the game's Controls (sometimes Controller, Wheel or Bindings) menu.
Pick your wheel or its preset if the game lists one.
For each row on Pitwall's card, find the game's action with that meaning (the names it may use are listed) and press the control on your wheel.
Save, then check each one on track. Pitwall can't see your wheel in this game.

not_possible.text: No game Pitwall knows lets you change ride height while driving. F1 25 and GT7 only show it in the car setup; iRacing's weight jacker on some oval cars is the closest thing.

Wing angles are a setup item in every game researched. F1 25 2026 cars switch Active Aero to Straight Line Mode on the DRS/S Mode button inside the zones only; other games have DRS on cars that have it.
GT7's stability control (ASM) and ABS are only in the pause menu, under Assistance Settings. They can't go on a button.
In F1 25, traction control and ABS are assists you set in the menu, not while driving.
{game} doesn't send wheel button presses, so Pitwall can't see your wheel. Talk to Pitwall with the iPad's talk button, or hold Space on a keyboard.

Pitwall can show the current value only where the game sends it: F1 25 brake bias and ERS mode. GT7 only says when TCS is working, not its level; Assetto Corsa on console only says whether TC and ABS are on and working.
